chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Abdullah ibn Waddah, from Sayf al-Tammari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) say: 'Whoever performs Hajj seeking Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, and does not seek therein show-off or fame, Allah will surely forgive him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Allah to forgive sins during Hajj?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores that the acceptance of Hajj hinges on the purity of intention, distinguishing true worship from social performance. It highlights the Shia emphasis on *ikhlas* (sincerity) as the spiritual core of the pilgrimage, promising absolute forgiveness (*al-battah*) for those who purify their hearts of *riya'* (show-off) and *sum'ah* (fame-seeking).
